card.name: Key noun ending a drug-warning heading
card.fires_on: The word that completes a short warning phrase, such as 'Retention' in the gadolinium heading, 'spinal' in 'high spinal', or 'exposure' after a drug name. It appears in label warning and interaction sections.

modes.label: Gadolinium Retention heading
modes.description: The last piece of the section title 'Gadolinium Retention' in contrast agent labels.
modes.example: 5.4 Gadolinium Ret<<ention>> Gadolinium is retained for months or

modes.label: High spinal reaction
modes.description: The word 'spinal' in 'high spinal' listed among test-dose reactions.
modes.example: The test dose itself may produce a systemic toxic reaction, high<< spinal>>, or cardiovascular effects from the epine

modes.label: Drug exposure decrease
modes.description: The word 'exposure' after a drug name in an interaction statement.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Due to a significant decrease in indinavir<< exposure>>, administration of a higher dose of ind
